html:
The Ngan'gimerri are an Aboriginal people of the Daly River area in the Northern Territory, southwest of Darwin.

Their language belongs to the Daly family, which is not part of the large Pama-Nyungan family. Neighbours on the map include the Malak Malak, the Marrithiyel and the Murrinh-Patha. Many Ngan'gimerri people later lived at the Daly River mission, now the community of Nauiyu. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Ngan'gimerri are an Aboriginal people of the Daly River area in the Northern Territory, southwest of Darwin.
